name: Verna's Westfall Stew Recipe
summary: As the Furlbrows prepare to leave their Westfall farm, Verna sends her stew recipe to Salma Saldean. Its familiar comfort may remain for those who stay.

sections.title: A Farewell Gift
sections.body:
Verna and Farmer Furlbrow have made their home in Westfall for years. Now the Defias Brotherhood and rogue harvest golems run rampant across the countryside. The Furlbrows wait for their wagon to be repaired so they can flee toward Stormwind.

While they wait, Verna writes down her beloved Westfall Stew formula. She entrusts it to travelers bound for her neighboring friend, Salma Saldean. That way, those left behind may still know the stew's familiar comfort.

faq.q: Why is Verna giving away her stew recipe?
faq.answer: Verna and Farmer Furlbrow are fleeing Westfall because bandits and rogue machines have overrun their fields. As they leave their farm, Verna hopes her friend Salma Saldean will keep making the stew for those who remain.

faq.q: Who is the recipe meant for?
aliases: who do i bring the recipe to
where does the stew recipe go
faq.answer: Verna's recipe is meant for Salma Saldean, who lives just beyond the fork in the road at the Saldean Farm.

faq.q: Where are the Furlbrows planning to go?
faq.answer: The Furlbrows are waiting for their wagon to be repaired so they can flee to Stormwind City. They seek safety from the chaos and brigandry threatening the countryside.

faq.q: What makes Westfall Stew notable in the region?
faq.answer: Westfall Stew is a regional staple made possible by local farming and game. With food scarce and farms abandoned, its hearty recipes help surviving farming families endure.

angles.text: For cooks, Verna's handwritten recipe preserves local knowledge as Westfall's farms fall into ruin.
For the Alliance, the recipe tells of loyal homesteaders driven from their land by lawlessness while Stormwind struggles to project its authority.
